name: finant

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/importers packages/i18n packages/assistant --pretty && npm run typecheck --workspace=@finant/mobile

//overrides: expo-router declares react-native-reanimated as a `*` peer, so npm resolves the newest publish (4.6.0 / worklets 0.12.x) instead of what the SDK ships. worklets 0.12 dropped WorkletRuntime::executeSync, which expo-modules-core still calls, and the iOS build fails to compile. Pinned to Expo SDK 57's bundledNativeModules.json. Re-check these on every SDK upgrade. react-native-gesture-handler arrives the same way and for the same reason: expo-router peers it as `*`, npm hoists the newest major (3.x) to the root while the workspace holds SDK 57's 2.32, and two copies of one native module is an autolinking coin toss.
